description.value: Orestes Greek Kouzina is a Greek restaurant located in Port Alberni on Vancouver Island, serving cuisine in a kouzina-style setting. The name evokes a traditional Greek kitchen atmosphere, making it a potential stop for touring cyclists passing through the Alberni Valley. Port Alberni sits at the heart of the island and is a common waypoint for cyclists on longer Vancouver Island routes.
